title: TGX-9 North Ridge Incident Report
note: First attempt at the deliverable. Looks finished but carries 16 seeded defects across value, figure, table, and page-element categories. Judged against the template rules plus reviewer comments.

sections.heading: 2. Description
sections.body: The TGX-9 gateway at North Ridge dropped 34 percent of inbound sensor packets over a two hour window. See Figure 2 for the network topology.

sections.heading: 3. Timeline
sections.body: Buffer occupancy alarm at 02:11; packet loss 02:14; recovery after manual power cycle at 06:31.

sections.heading: 4. Contributing Factors
sections.body: Firmware 4.2.0 was running on the affected unit. Cabinet temperature was elevated during the event.

_seeded_defects: 1. Value: firmware is 4.2.0 but should be 4.2.1.
2. Value: outage duration says 'two hour' but should be 'four hour'.
3. Missing content: the Corrective Actions text and table rows are empty.
4. Value: severity 'Low' is challenged and the correct value is unknown, so it needs review or becomes a conflict.
5. Figure: the Timeline figure is named 'figure1.png' but should be 'packet_loss_vs_temp.png' (needs relabel).
6. Figure: 'cabinet_thermal_layout.png' is placed in Description but belongs in Contributing Factors (needs to move).
7. Figure: 'site_network_topology.png' is missing from Description entirely (needs to be inserted).
8. Table: column order is Owner, Action, Due Date but should lead with Action.
9. Table: the required 'Verification' column is missing.
10. Table: font is Comic Sans with a plain header, but the template requires Arial with a table-header style.
11. Page elements: the 'Figure 2' cross-reference in Description points to a figure that is not placed there (dangling reference).
12. Page elements: the Timeline figure has no caption, but the template requires one.
13. Page elements: figure numbers are missing or stale and must be renumbered in order.
14. Page elements: the Corrective Actions table has no title, but the template requires one.
15. Page elements: the footer is empty, so page numbers and the classification marking are missing.
16. Conflict: two reviewers assign different severities (High vs Medium).
